_description: Digestible -> standard-MCP tool-name translation for the runner's MCP integration layer (SoT nd-473). Agents are prompted with the DIGESTIBLE names (left); the runner translates each detected call to the standard MCP tool name (right) before forwarding via tools/call. The unharness MCP server's names are already verbose and purpose-driven, so the seed map is identity; the layer exists so a simpler agent-facing surface (or a role-scoped subset) can be presented without touching the industry-standard server.
